about.metaDescription: GroupToStay is the B2B marketplace built exclusively for group accommodation sourcing and hotel quotations.
about.ogDescription: Learn how GroupToStay connects group organizers with verified hotels for competitive group quotations.
about.title: About GroupToStay
about.body: GroupToStay is a B2B marketplace built exclusively for group accommodation. We connect operators who book at scale with hotels that specialize in serving them. Our mission is to remove the friction from group hotel sourcing — replacing dozens of emails and phone calls with a single, transparent workflow.
